heading: Featured Systems & Projects
description: Enterprise compliance platforms, climate-smart agronomy engines, generative AI assistants, and explainable computer vision architectures.

projects.title: CampusSphere
projects.tagline: Enterprise Accreditation & Institutional Credit Banking System
projects.description: Multi-tier enterprise compliance and credit banking platform for higher education institutions. Streamlines student co-curricular verification via a two-stage pipeline (Faculty Advisor Stage 1 & Admin Stage 2), dynamic Credit Policy Engine mapped to NAAC Criteria 1–7, cryptographic public credential verification (/verify/[id]), and 1-click NAAC/NIRF CSV compliance reports.

projects.title: JalDrishti (जलदृष्टि)
projects.description: State-of-the-art precision irrigation and crop advisory platform for Indian agriculture. Combines FAO-56 Penman-Monteith Evapotranspiration modeling, SoilGrids satellite physics, Smart Rain Hold warnings (≥5.0mm override), weather-driven pathogen risk forecasting for 5 critical crops, and JalSathi AI—a multilingual voice-enabled RAG agronomy assistant.

projects.title: RecipeAI
projects.tagline: Generative AI Sous-Chef & Culinary Intelligence Web App
projects.description: Context-aware culinary AI web application that brings an expert AI Sous-Chef into the kitchen. Features Pantry Chef (ingredient-first zero-waste cooking), on-demand dish generation, real-time context-aware conversational AI assistant powered by Llama-3.3-70B, Clerk JWT authentication, and Supabase Postgres activity history.

projects.title: FruitQ-GradeX
projects.tagline: Explainable Deep Learning Fruit Quality Grading
projects.description: Multi-task deep learning system that simultaneously classifies fruit species and grades commercial quality. Powered by a custom multi-headed CNN achieving 97.75% fruit classification accuracy and 98.21% quality accuracy across 9,146 images with Grad-CAM decision heatmaps and real-time webcam inference.
